parts.source:
&V10 = "abc"
&C10 = "ABCDEFGHIJ"
msg("o_v10_len_decl=[" + Substr(&V10, 1, 10) + "]", status)
msg("o_v10_len_over=[" + Substr(&V10, 2, 5) + "]", status)
msg("o_v10_start_end=[" + Substr(&V10, 4, 2) + "]", status)
msg("o_c10_len_over=[" + Substr(&C10, 8, 5) + "]", status)
msg("o_c10_len_decl_over=[" + Substr(&C10, 1, 11) + "]", status)
&V10 = "ABCDEFGHIJ"
msg("o_v10_full_end=[" + Substr(&V10, 10, 1) + "]", status)
msg("o_v10_full_len_over=[" + Substr(&V10, 8, 5) + "]", status)
msg("o_v10_len_0=[" + Substr(&V10, 2, 0) + "]", status)
msg("o_v10_start_gt=[" + Substr(&V10, 11, 1) + "]", status)
msg("o_m_v10_start_gt=[" + &V10.Substring(11, 1) + "]", status)

msg("o_v10_start_neg=[" + Substr(&V10, -1, 2) + "]", status)

msg("o_c10_start_gt=[" + Substr(&C10, 11, 1) + "]", status)
msg("o_c10_start_0=[" + Substr(&C10, 0, 3) + "]", status)

&V10 = ""
msg("o_v10_empty_1_1=[" + Substr(&V10, 1, 1) + "]", status)
msg("o_v10_empty_len0=[" + Substr(&V10, 1, 0) + "]", status)
msg("o_replace_empty_find=[" + StrReplace(&V10, "", "X") + "]", status)
msg("o_replace_empty_with=[" + StrReplace("abc", "b", "") + "]", status)
